parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json;if(x.retCode!==0||!Array.isArray(x.result?.list))throw Error("Invalid Bybit public API");const symbols=["BTCUSDT","ETHUSDT","SOLUSDT"];const market=symbols.map(symbol=>{const t=x.result.list.find(v=>v.symbol===symbol);const price=Number(t?.lastPrice),change24hPct=Number(t?.price24hPcnt)*100;if(!(price>0)||!Number.isFinite(change24hPct))throw Error("Missing price "+symbol);return {symbol,price,change24hPct};});return [{json:{market,observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),trade_execution:false}}];

const market=$("Market Snapshot").first().json;const feed=$input.first().json||{};const base={ready:false,market:market.market,observed_at:market.observed_at,reason:"Master Trader source unconfigured",trades:[],keys:[],trade_execution:false};if(feed.status!=="ok"||feed.source!=="authorized_feed"||!Array.isArray(feed.trades))return [{json:base}];const updated=Date.parse(feed.updated_at||"");if(!Number.isFinite(updated)||Date.now()-updated>48*3600000||updated>Date.now()+300000)return [{json:{...base,reason:"Master archive stale"}}];const state=$getWorkflowStaticData("global");const delivered=state.sentTradeKeys||{};const unique=new Set();const current=[];for(const t of feed.trades.slice(0,1000)){if(!t||typeof t!=="object")continue;const trader=String(t.trader||"").slice(0,80),symbol=String(t.symbol||"").toUpperCase(),side=String(t.side||""),ts=Date.parse(t.opened_at||""),price=Number(t.entry_price),url=String(t.source_url||"");if(!trader||!/^[A-Z0-9]{4,24}$/.test(symbol)||!["Buy","Sell","Long","Short"].includes(side)||!Number.isFinite(ts)||ts>Date.now()+300000||Date.now()-ts>30*86400000||!(price>0)||!/^https:\/\/(www\.)?bybit\.com\//.test(url))continue;const key=[trader,symbol,side,new Date(ts).toISOString(),price].join("|");if(unique.has(key)||delivered[key])continue;unique.add(key);current.push({key,trader,symbol,side,opened_at:new Date(ts).toISOString(),entry_price:price,closed_at:String(t.closed_at||""),exit_price:t.exit_price||null,source_url:url});if(current.length>=10)break;}if(!current.length)return [{json:{...base,reason:"No new sourced trades"}}];return [{json:{...base,ready:true,trades:current.map(({key,...rest})=>rest),keys:current.map(t=>t.key),prompt:JSON.stringify({market:market.market,observed_at:market.observed_at,trades:current.map(({key,...rest})=>rest),caution:"External feed is not independently verified; not a trading signal."}).slice(0,11500)}}];

const keys=$("Format JEV Message").first().json.keys||[];const state=$getWorkflowStaticData("global");if(!state.sentTradeKeys||typeof state.sentTradeKeys!=="object")state.sentTradeKeys={};for(const k of keys)state.sentTradeKeys[k]=Date.now();state.sentTradeKeys=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(state.sentTradeKeys).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).slice(0,2000));return [{json:{status:"sent",count:keys.length,trade_execution:false}}];
